description: Check SysML v2 text (or KerML, with language "kerml") against the MBEstudio profile: syntax, name resolution, typing, units, and evaluation errors. Call it after every change. Output: { valid, errors, roots, diagnostics: [{ severity, code, message, line, column, hint }] }.

language.description: The notation of the text: "sysml" (default) or "kerml" for a KerML document (.kerml).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

name: validate
title: Validate a model
